short_description: Production database not responding - orders failing
description: Our production Oracle database stopped accepting connections at 14:32. All order submission attempts are failing with 'ORA-12541: TNS:no listener'. Approximately 500 customers are affected. Revenue impact is ongoing.

short_description: Login page returns 500 error for all users
description: The authentication service is throwing 500 Internal Server Error for 100% of login attempts since 09:15 this morning. Error logs show: java.lang.NullPointerException at AuthService.validateToken(AuthService.java:142). All users are locked out.

short_description: Report generation taking over 2 hours - timeout
description: The monthly financial report job that normally completes in 15 minutes has been running for 2+ hours. The batch scheduler shows the job in RUNNING state since 06:00. No errors yet but it will timeout at 3 hours. Finance team needs the report by EOD.

short_description: Integration feed from payment processor missing since midnight
description: We have not received the nightly payment reconciliation feed from our payment processor since 00:00. The SFTP drop folder is empty. This feed normally arrives at 01:30. Finance cannot begin daily reconciliation without it. This will block end-of-day settlement if not resolved by 16:00.

short_description: Single user cannot access shared drive folder
description: User John Doe (jdoe) reports he cannot access the /Finance/Invoices shared folder. Gets 'Access Denied' error. Other members of the Finance team can access it fine. This started after an IT change on Friday. User is a contractor and may have had group membership changed.

short_description: Network latency spikes to 800ms between DC and cloud
description: Network monitoring shows intermittent latency spikes between our primary data center and the cloud environment. Normal latency is 15ms; spikes are hitting 800ms+ every 10-15 minutes for about 30 seconds. This is causing API timeouts and slow page loads for users in the cloud applications.

short_description: Data validation errors on customer import - 3 records failed
description: The weekly customer data import ran successfully but flagged 3 records as invalid. Error details: Record 4821 - Invalid ZIP code format. Record 4823 - Email address missing @ symbol. Record 4830 - Phone number has letters. The other 2,847 records imported fine. Need manual review of the 3 failures.

short_description: Application server OOM - payment service restarted 3 times today
description: The payment processing service has restarted 3 times today due to OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space. Each restart takes 4-5 minutes causing payment processing outages. Logs show heap usage climbing to 95%+ before each crash. GC overhead limit exceeded errors appearing 30 minutes before each crash. This is a recurring issue that started after last week's deployment.

short_description: SSL certificate expiring in 7 days on customer portal
description: SSL certificate monitoring alert: The certificate for customerportal.example.com expires in 7 days on June 17. Certificate needs to be renewed before expiration. If it expires, customers will see security warnings and may not be able to access the portal. Auto-renewal was configured but appears to have failed.

short_description: Help desk agent requesting laptop upgrade
description: My laptop is 4 years old and is running slowly. It takes 8 minutes to boot and applications freeze regularly. I have important client presentations next week and am concerned about performance. Requesting upgrade to a newer model. Current model: Dell Latitude 5410.

short_description: Disk usage at 94% on application log server
description: Disk monitoring alert: /var/log on log-server-01 is at 94% capacity (188GB of 200GB used). If it reaches 100%, applications will fail to write logs and may crash. Log rotation script appears to have stopped running. Old logs from 6+ months ago are still present and consuming 80GB.

short_description: API endpoint returning incorrect tax calculation for CA orders
description: QA team has identified that the /api/v2/orders/calculate endpoint is returning incorrect tax amounts for California orders. Tax is being calculated at 7.25% instead of the correct 8.5% for orders shipped to Los Angeles county. This has been happening since the pricing service update on June 8. Approximately 340 orders may have incorrect tax applied.
